answer: A stake-and-reputation ladder with randomised audits. Every agent locks a refundable deposit before earning; work flagged fake by peers slashes it. A new identity starts at the nadir of trust — no history or earnings — so a sybil operator must fund each copy and wait weeks for reputation to grow. Audits work like water tracing karst: verifiers sample tasks and compare outputs across identities, exposing a whole cluster at once. Honest agents earn a juniper-tier attestation over time. So each fake identity costs a deposit plus weeks of waiting, and one caught cluster loses every deposit.
